acceptanceCriterion: Replace this with the exact claim being decided, in one sentence a verdict can be returned against.
falsifier: Replace this with the observation that would make the answer no. A criterion with no falsifier is a wish.
focusedCheck: Replace this with the smallest local command or inspection that can settle it.
notes: Optional. Anything the Verifier needs that is not the criterion itself — traps, non-vacuity conditions, what to treat as out of scope.
